description: This Java source file defines the KuraProtocolAdapter class, a Vert.x-based protocol adapter for Eclipse Hono that handles publishing messages from Eclipse Kura gateways to Hono's Telemetry and Event APIs. It includes methods for mapping MQTT topics to Hono resource identifiers, handling message publication, and differentiating control and data messages based on topic structure and QoS levels.

classes.name: KuraProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter, providing MQTT topic mapping and message handling for Eclipse Kura gateways within Hono.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of the protocol adapter, specifically 'kura'.

methods.name: onPublishedMessage
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when a message is published; maps the MQTT topic and uploads the message, with error handling.

methods.name: mapTopic
methods.description: Maps an MQTT topic to a Hono resource identifier, differentiating control and data messages, and validates topic format.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the appropriate endpoint string ('telemetry' or 'event') based on QoS level.
